fee_notes: Royalty 5.0% of GRR monthly. Marketing and Reservation Fee 3.0% of GRR, subject to change up to 5%. PMS Monthly Support $734–$1,050/month (SynXis or OPERA Foundation/Standard); OPERA Premium $13.25/room/month. Loyalty Program Charge 4.25%–5.5% of member-earn amounts. Digital PFP Commission currently 7% up to 10% of GRR. Standard RMS optional at 0.75% GRR ($645–$1,395/month); Premium RMS 1.00% GRR ($1,450–$2,450/month, or $3,500/month if annual GRR ≥$3M). Wyndham Connect Plus required at 3.5% of GRR per reservation.
raw_excerpt: Royalty Fee 5.0% of Gross Room Revenues ("GRR"). Monthly by the 3rd day of the month after GRR accrue. Marketing and Reservation Fee 3.0% of GRR. Same as Royalty.
